title: Had I known, should you need: đảo ngữ điều kiện
summary: Bỏ if và đảo trợ động từ lên đầu: Should you need…, Were I you…, Had I known…; dùng trong văn trang trọng.

dialogue.en: Thank you for staying at our hotel.
dialogue.vi: Cảm ơn quý khách đã ở khách sạn chúng tôi.

dialogue.en: It was lovely. [[Had I known]], I would have stayed longer.
dialogue.vi: Rất tuyệt. Biết vậy tôi đã ở lâu hơn.

dialogue.en: [[Should you need]] anything else, please call us.
dialogue.vi: Nếu quý khách cần gì thêm, xin cứ gọi.

dialogue.en: Thanks. Can I leave my bag here until three?
dialogue.vi: Cảm ơn. Tôi gửi túi ở đây đến ba giờ được không?

dialogue.en: Of course. [[Were I]] you, I'd visit the old market.
dialogue.vi: Tất nhiên. Nếu là quý khách, tôi sẽ đi chợ cũ.
Ý hay. Tôi đi ngay đây.

sections.heading: Should + S + V
sections.rule: **If + S + should + V** → bỏ if, đảo: **Should + S + V** = nếu (chẳng may). Rất hay gặp trong email, thông báo trang trọng.

examples.en: [[Should you have]] any questions, please contact us.
examples.vi: Nếu có thắc mắc, xin liên hệ chúng tôi.

examples.en: [[Should the flight be]] delayed, we will inform you.
examples.vi: Nếu chuyến bay bị hoãn, chúng tôi sẽ báo quý khách.

check.prompt: ___ you need help, call this number.
check.explain: Đảo ngữ loại 1: Should + S + V.

sections.heading: Were + S + (to V)
sections.rule: **If + S + were** → **Were + S**. Với động từ khác: **Were + S + to V**.

examples.en: [[Were I]] you, I would accept the offer.
examples.vi: Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ nhận lời.

examples.en: [[Were the company to close]], 500 people would lose their jobs.
examples.vi: Nếu công ty đóng cửa, 500 người sẽ mất việc.

check.prompt: ___ I rich, I would travel the world.

sections.heading: Had + S + V3
sections.rule: **If + S + had + V3** → **Had + S + V3**. Phủ định: **Had + S + not + V3** (không rút gọn hadn't ở đầu câu).

examples.en: [[Had I known]], I would have called you.
examples.vi: Biết vậy tôi đã gọi bạn.

examples.en: [[Had she not helped]] us, we would have failed.
examples.vi: Nếu cô ấy không giúp, chúng tôi đã thất bại.
examples.why: Phủ định: Had + S + not + V3.

examples.en: [[Had we left]] earlier, we would have caught the train.
examples.vi: Nếu đi sớm hơn, chúng tôi đã kịp tàu.

check.prompt: ___ he studied harder, he would have passed.
check.explain: Đảo ngữ loại 3: Had + S + V3.

mistakes.wrong: Had I know, I would have come.
mistakes.right: Had I known, I would have come.

mistakes.wrong: Hadn't she helped us, we would have failed.
mistakes.right: Had she not helped us, we would have failed.
mistakes.why: Phủ định: Had + S + not + V3.

mistakes.wrong: Should you will need help, call me.
mistakes.right: Should you need help, call me.

mistakes.wrong: Was I you, I would go.
mistakes.right: Were I you, I would go.
mistakes.why: Đảo ngữ dùng were cho mọi chủ ngữ.

mistakes.wrong: If had I known, I would have told you.
mistakes.right: Had I known, I would have told you.

exercises.prompt: ___ you require further information, please email us.
___ I in your position, I would say no.
___ they arrived on time, they would have seen the show.

options: Had we not left early, we would have missed it.
Hadn't we left early, we would have missed it.
exercises.explain: Phủ định đảo ngữ: Had + S + not.

exercises.prompt: Should you ___ your card, call the bank at once.
___ I known about the party, I would have come.
___ you have any problems, let me know.
Were the government ___ taxes, people would protest.
Had she ___ the warning, she would have stayed home.

exercises.vi: Nếu tôi là bạn, tôi sẽ đi bác sĩ.
Biết vậy tôi đã không đến.

exercises.sentence: Had I knew the answer, I would have told you.
answers: Had I known the answer, I would have told you.

exercises.sentence: Should you will have questions, ask the staff.
answers: Should you have questions, ask the staff.

exercises.sentence: Was I rich, I would buy a boat.
answers: Were I rich, I would buy a boat.

exercises.vi: Nếu quý khách cần giúp đỡ, xin bấm chuông.
answers: Should you need help, please ring the bell.
Should you need any help, please ring the bell.

If you need help, please ring the bell.
Should you need help, ring the bell.
